message.content: Apple's FY2024 results (quarter ended Sept 28, 2024) are confirmed by both the newsroom release and the 10-K: revenue $391.0B, net income $93.7B ($93,736M), diluted EPS $6.08 — with Q4 revenue up 6% YoY to $94.9B. That's a return to growth despite a one-time $10.2B tax charge, so I'll buy within the mandate.
message.reasoning:
